draft_en.subject: For the camera sites where you use Itoonertech or Dahua PFS - an 8-port managed PoE at $84.1
draft_en.body:
Hello iFocus team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 25 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the camera sites in Pattaya and Chonburi where you now use Itoonertech or Dahua PFS3110 PoE switches, neutral-brand, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP uplinks, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $84.1 USD; budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $26.2.

One question: which one do you install most - 8-port or 16-port PoE?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
